step_1: 1. Connect the Wi-Fi dongle to the USB port of your PC.
step_2: 2. Click the image below to open the Adapter Settings window.
step_3: 3. Check the Wi-Fi interface name for the TP-Link Wireless USB Adapter (e.g., Wi-Fi 2).
step_4: 4. Click the image below to open the Wi-Fi Connection window.
step_5: 5. Select the interface, choose the Wi-Fi starting with jajucha_, and enter the security key jajucha123.
